routing.list.title: Routing Rules
routing.list.intro: Control which requests repositories allow or block
routing.list.name: Name
routing.list.emptyText: Create routing rules to decide which requests proxy repositories allow or block.
routing.list.noMatchesText: No routing rule matches the filter. Try another one.
routing.list.whatText: Routing rules allow or block requests to proxy repositories by patterns of the request path. The patterns are regular expressions.
routing.form.name: Name
routing.form.nameHint: A unique name of the routing rule
routing.form.descriptionHint: An optional description of the routing rule
routing.form.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe what the routing rule does

routing.form.assignedWarning.other: The routing rule is assigned to {count} repositories: {names}. Remove it from every repository before deleting it.

routing.preview.intro: See how routing rules treat a request in every repository
